news.title: WSJ独家：Moonshot AI重组为IPO铺路
news.snippet: [中国AI初创企业Moonshot AI正进行重组，为首次公开募股（IPO）铺平道路。]
news.raw_snippet:
Chinese artificial-intelligence startup Moonshot AI is wrapping up a corporate restructuring that would pave the way for an initial public offering.

Moonshot’s operations are mainly in China, but it has a holding company incorporated in the Cayman Islands. Many of its early backers invested in that entity in dollars. Now, Moonshot is deactivating the holding company and moving investors’ stakes to its primary operating entity in China, according to people familiar with the matter. news.snippet: [前沿AI企业Aaru将在纽约市扩张，预计创造超过650个新就业岗位。]
news.raw_snippet: Aaru Co-Founder and CEO Cameron Fink said, “We made a deliberate decision to build Aaru in New York City. The depth and diversity of talent here, proximity to the world’s largest enterprises, and the city’s history of innovation make it the right place for what we’re building. Being a New York company is core to our DNA, and we’re grateful to Governor Hochul and Empire State Development for their belief in Aaru.” [...] Empire State Development President, CEO and Commissioner Hope Knight said, “Aaru’s remarkable growth demonstrates what is possible when innovative companies have the talent, resources, and support they need to succeed. Founded in New York City just two years ago, the company has rapidly emerged as a major player in artificial intelligence, and this expansion represents an important investment in its future. Under Governor Hochul’s leadership, we’re helping companies like Aaru scale their [...] Aaru’s founders are remaining in New York City and are building its next phase here due to the State’s talent, its proximity to global business and a strong innovation ecosystem. New jobs will span software engineering, computer and information research, product development, enterprise sales, client management, and corporate operations.

news.title: Washoe County推出Search Assistant提升数字信息获取
news.snippet: [该县将推出Search Assistant，帮助居民更便捷地获取县府服务与资源信息。]
news.raw_snippet:
Finding information about Washoe County services and resources will be a lot easier with the launch of the Washoe County Search Assistant, a conversational, artificial intelligence-powered tool now available on washoecounty.gov. The tool will launch on Tuesday, Nov. 17. [...] Using the Washoe County Search Assistant is easy!  

 Visitors at washoecounty.gov can access the Washoe County Search Assistant by clicking the “Search Assistant” button in the bottom-right corner of any page on washoecounty.gov.

 Once opened, select “Start Chat” to begin, then enter and send your question in the message field.

 The Search Assistant will use artificial intelligence to understand your request, find relevant information and generate a response. [...] 6. Can I trust the information provided by the Washoe County Search Assistant?

Yes, however the Washoe County Search Assistant does use artificial intelligence to generate responses, which may occasionally contain inaccurate, incomplete, or outdated information. We encourage you to verify important information using the provided references or by contacting 311 or the appropriate Washoe County department.
